verdict.rationale:
Cerebras is fundamentally a headless REST API with official Python/Node SDKs, API-key auth, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a Batch API for asynchronous automated workloads — all naturally scriptable/CI-friendly without any UI dependency. Community evidence also shows third-party CLI plugins (llm-cerebras) and agentic/coding-loop usage consistent with automated pipelines.

missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) or documentation calling out headless/automation use cases by name.
